title: NBI raids suspected scam hub in Subic; 230 persons taken into custody

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has taken into custody 230 individuals during a raid on a suspected scam hub in Subic, Zambales, with authorities still determining who among them may be victims of human trafficking and who may face criminal charges.
